info.name: Rillet Accounting API Key Invoice payments API

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of rows to return in the page.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor to navigate through the full response.

params.name: updated.gt
params.description: Filter payments updated after this timestamp

params.name: sort_by
params.description: the field the payments should be sorted by descending (either created or updated)

items.docs:
Pages every customer payment recorded against invoices across the organization, independent of which invoice it settled.
Use updated.gt and sort_by when syncing integrations; follow the pagination cursor until no next page remains.

info.name: Lists payments for a given invoice

params.name: invoice_id
params.description: UUID of the invoice to be used in this operation.

items.docs:
Returns every payment attempt tied to a single invoice, including successful, uncleared, and failed rows with their public status.
Pair with retrieve-an-invoice when reconciling an account statement against what Rillet already applied.

params.name: invoice_id
params.description: UUID of the invoice to be used in this operation.

items.docs:
Records a manual cash receipt against an open invoice by amount, effective date, and a GL account code that maps to a funded cash account.
Rillet resolves the account code to a cash account before posting, so verify chart-of-accounts mapping when automations fail validation.

params.name: invoice_id
params.description: UUID of the invoice to be used in this operation.

params.name: payment_id
params.description: UUID of the payment to be used in this operation.

items.docs:
Replaces the amount, date, and cash account on an existing uncleared invoice payment.
Only uncleared payments can be updated; cleared or reconciled payments are rejected.
This is a full-replace operation (PUT semantics) — include all fields in the request body.

params.name: invoice_id
params.description: UUID of the invoice to be used in this operation.

params.name: payment_id
params.description: UUID of the payment to be used in this operation.

items.docs:
Reverses a previously recorded uncleared invoice payment, restoring the invoice balance accordingly.
Only uncleared payments can be deleted; cleared or reconciled payments are rejected.
Treat this as a corrective action with the same controls you apply to voiding treasury transactions in your close process.
